Package com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model

package com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model
Fabric domain model interfaces for the Equinix Java SDK. Defines read-only data access contracts for Fabric resources including Connection, Port, CloudRouter, Network, Stream, RouteFilter, RouteAggregation, RoutingProtocol, and PrecisionTime. Mutable resources expose update and delete operations through their wrapper implementations.
